_comment: Illustration prompts for designs that still have no photo. Run catalog/generate_illustrations.py (needs GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env), check each image by eye, then run name_images.py, build_studio.py and seed_designs.py. The script removes an entry once its image is saved.

prompts.kids-tiny-flower-dots: Elegant digital illustration (clearly not a photograph), soft painterly style with fine clean linework. The image shows a young child's small open right palm facing the viewer, fingers slightly spread, exactly five fingers, palm side so no fingernails are visible. The mehndi design: One small flower in the middle of the palm - done in minutes. Style: floral mehndi. Everything drawn on the skin is monochrome reddish-brown henna only - no other colours. Warm natural skin. Plain warm ivory background (#FBF6EC), soft even light, subtle soft shadow, centred with space around the subject. No jewellery, no bangles, no rings, no text, no letters, no watermark, no face, no extra people.
